summary: Four New Session launches through the relay each returned 200 with a host advSessionId (17, 18, 19, 20). The avi-test operator's own ended-sessions list returns those rows with workspaceId ws-3daf37098c8096b5d9e0ac72, agent claude, a host pid (e.g. 17: pid 11074, sessionId d0e09d6a-3d3e-40d1-ad9d-7adf590fbb5c, started 14:11:25Z) and the host fleet-log path under /var/lib/papercusp/.papercusp/fleet-logs. Each session's transcript is on the VM in the customer home (/home/papercusp-workspace/.claude/projects/-home-papercusp-workspace/<sessionId>.jsonl) with a completed assistant turn, and sessions 19/20 reported their own process ancestry on the VM (claude uid 1001 under sshd, supervised by psu.mjs as the service user). Chain: control-plane connector ticket (hostedSessionId wi10003163-chat-<ts>) -> relay -> host launch-su -> host adv session row -> VM process + transcript. None of this exists on the control plane.
